verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents a first-party conversational AI assistant that answers questions about selected files or knowledge bases and summarizes them. It also offers AI Search (natural-language semantic search), AI-trained auto-tagging, and AI steps in workflows. A customer quote on Egnyte's own site describes querying across multiple documents in natural language, which suggests the feature has shipped. Explicit extraction (pulling structured fields or data out of files) is not documented; auto-tagging and OCR are classification and search features, not extraction. Missing for 10: documented data or field extraction from files, in-depth product documentation beyond pricing and marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, the storage understands its contents — a first-party AI surface (ask questions of files, summarize, extract) shipped and documented, not just announced

citations.quote: Conversational AI assistant capable of answering questions and summarizing multiple selected files or knowledge bases, and generating content such as emails, memos, proposals, etc.
semantic search across all connected content repositories using natural language rather than keywords.
Now, our brokers can query across multiple documents in natural language to search for terms and conditions and compare files.
Ability to train AI using a sample document set to automatically recognize and tag similar documents.
